C52.content_en:
Ways to see the keywords two articles share — and how the main tools compare

When you write a blog post, you want to know which keywords two top-ranking articles overlap on. Enter two article URLs and this tool lists up to 100 keywords both appear for, with each page's position and the search volume.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.019 per call for 62 rows (measured); about $0.024 at 100 rows (measured in Japan)Shared keywords of two article URLs, each with its position and volume. Save as CSV
Ahrefs Site Explorer (Content gap)Subscription (see the official site for plans)A feature to find keywords a rival ranks for and you do not (see the official site). Centered on domain-level comparison
Semrush Keyword GapSubscription (see the official site for plans)Compares your site's keywords with rivals' (see the official site). Domain-level
Reading the results yourself (by hand)FreeCheck two articles' positions keyword by keyword. Laborious as the list grows

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • Compare at the article (URL) level. See the overlap between articles, not whole sites.
  • Positions side by side. For two blog guides on how to start a blog (shopify.com and wix.com), "how to start a blogger" showed the Shopify page at 9th and the Wix page at 2nd (and 4th in another row) (measured).
  • 62 rows. These two pages gave 62 rows in total. The same keyword can take several rows, so there are fewer distinct keywords than rows (measured).
  • About $0.019 per call. About 50 per $1 at 62 rows, about 40 per $1 at 100 rows.
  • Save as CSV.

When it is not the right fit

  • You want keywords only one page has (your gaps) → only keywords both appear for are returned.
  • When nothing is shared → the table is empty but the call still costs $0.012 (measured in Japan with two Japanese articles).
  • The same keyword repeats → keywords such as "how to start a blogger" and "how do i start a blog" appear in several rows with different position pairs (measured). This tool cannot tell why.
  • You want more than 100 → it stops at 100.

This tool does one thing: show 100 keywords two URLs both appear for, with positions and volume.

FAQ

Do I enter domains?

No, article (page) URLs. Enter two URLs starting with "https://".

Why can the result be empty?

The two pages do not both appear for any same keyword. The call is still charged.

Why does the same keyword repeat?

The API returns it that way. In our sample the same keyword appeared in several rows with different position pairs. This tool cannot tell why; we show them as they come.

In what order are the rows?

By search volume, descending. The tool sorts them that way.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?

C53.content_en:
Ways to check the estimated traffic of many sites at once — and how the main tools compare

Once you have a list of sales prospects, you want to see how much customer traffic each one gets from search all at once. Enter domains one per line and this tool tabulates each one's estimated traffic.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.012 for 3 domains (measured with target.com, walmart.com and bestbuy.com); about $0.024 for 100 (a guide; we measured up to 3)Estimated traffic for several domains in one table. Save as CSV
Semrush Bulk AnalysisSubscription (see the official site for plans)See the official site for whether it can analyze several domains at once
SimilarwebSubscription (its pricing page lists a Starter plan from $125/month)A service that estimates site traffic and more (see the official site for features)
One by one into a spreadsheet (by hand)Depends on the tools you useLaborious, but realistic for a short list

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • Check a whole list at once. Line up your prospects and compare their size.
  • About $0.012 for 3 domains.
  • A clean two-column table. Domain and estimated traffic (in the sample, walmart.com about 142.7 million, target.com about 57.6 million, bestbuy.com about 26.6 million; measured).
  • A few seconds. The 3-domain sample (target.com, walmart.com, bestbuy.com) came back in under a second.
  • Save as CSV. Sort in a spreadsheet to prioritize your outreach.

When it is not the right fit

  • You want a prospect's real customer traffic → the estimated traffic here is a modeled figure (per DataForSEO) and not necessarily real visitors.
  • You want ads (paid) numbers → only organic search is shown.
  • You also want keyword counts or positions → this table shows estimated traffic only. For one site at a time, "See a site's estimated traffic" fits better.
  • The price for up to 100 domains is a guide. We measured up to 3.
  • The rows do not always follow your input order → in a test in Japan with Japanese domains, one came before another that was entered earlier. In the US sample the order matched the input.

This tool does one thing: show the estimated search traffic of several domains at once.

FAQ

How many domains can I enter?

DataForSEO's spec says up to 1000 per call. We confirmed up to 3 here.

How do I write the domains?

One per line, like "example.com".

Does the price change with the number of domains?

3 domains cost about $0.012 (measured). The price for more domains is untested.

What do country and language change?

The market for the numbers. The US and English give numbers for US results.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?
